biotools.summary: CIEVAD is a collection of Nextflow workflows designed to facilitate rapid and on-demand deployment of end-to-end testing of genomic variant detection. It allows for the generation of synthetic test data and the evaluation of variant sets against that data.
biotools.name: CIEVAD
